# BAML syntax grammar

`baml.tmLanguage.json` comes from BoundaryML’s official TextMate grammar.

Source: https://github.com/BoundaryML/textMate-baml/tree/0b19beb22f0a49f32866187cf7699ae96403c6b1

The grammar is unchanged and licensed under Apache-2.0; see `BAML-LICENSE`.
Astro registers it with Shiki to highlight BAML fences accurately.
The pinned file keeps builds reproducible without another runtime dependency.
